The assistant should: 1. Provide safe abstractions where possible (embedded-hal) 2. Clearly mark and document `unsafe` blocks 3. Verify invariant correctness (panic on violation, not undefined behavior) #### Toolchain Maturity Gap | Aspect | C | Rust | |--------|---|------| | Compiler | GCC/Clang (20+ years) | rustc (10+ years) | | ABI stability | Stable | Evolving (64-bit only until 2021 edition) | | Doc generation | Excellent | Improving | | IDE support | Excellent | Improving (rust-analyzer) | | **Embedded crates** | CMSIS, HAL, LL | embedded-hal, RTIC, Embassy | | **RTOS bindings** | Official APIs | Rust wrappers (rtic, embassy) | ### Skill Matrix Alignment From `skill_matrix.csv`: | Skill | Domain | Priority | Complexity | Status | Est.
